codet:
I computed each expected output with the standard reduction: map each point to u = x+y and v = x−y. The Manhattan diameter of a set is max(maxU−minU, maxV−minV). Removing a non-extreme point never shrinks the diameter, so the answer is the minimum diameter after removing one of the four extreme points (max u, min u, max v, min v).
